details.repeated_hypothesis_note: 492 registered versions are not 492 independent trials; age-5 cumulative/recent5 predicates and some realized paths overlap. No deduplication changes the approved pool or rank.

pending_terminal_original_signal_limit.scope: Original BASE signal generation is inherited from hash-bound, previously audited IS evidence. A terminal unfilled original entry/exit/reversal cannot be reconstructed from executions alone; its saved signal is structurally checked and disclosed. No such distinction changes observed IS PnL. All filled paths, checkpoint facts, actual exits and returns are independently rebuilt.

details.quality_definition: Eligible closed trades entered and closed within each window; flats included in expectancy denominator. Gross PF = gross wins/gross absolute losses, zero wins = 0, zero losses undefined. Strict finite FILTER > BASE for both quality metrics, no selection epsilon.
details.ledger_dollar_compatibility: pnl_usd/price_pnl_usd are independently checked legacy compounded-dollar fields. net_pnl_usd is fixed-principal simple dollars; the SCREEN and PF/expectancy use gross_simple_return_pct, not legacy dollar fields.
details.fresh_sample_warning: Earlier exits can add eligible closed trades near boundaries; formal SCREEN uses actual closed cohorts. This audit does not add paired-cohort gates.
details.historical_review_pending_flag: Preserved as the original review snapshot; current authorization is recorded in the new protocol.
details.historical_OOS_exposure: Historical 2023-05-30 to 2026-05-29 observations have already been seen in other campaigns. This is repeated historical verification, not untouched independent evidence. The original v3/v4 campaigns stopped with no IS-frozen candidates and no OOS evaluation.
